text: 在“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题市政府新闻发布会上，上海市文旅局党组书记、局长赵勇介绍了最新印发实施的《上海市都市旅游创新发展“十五五”规划》。《规划》锚定建设中国入境旅游第一站、中国都市旅游首选地、文旅深度融合示范区三大目标，提出到2030年上海旅游收入力争突破9000亿元，入境游客达1000万人次以上，旅游产业增加值占全市GDP比重达到5%，力争跻身全球旅游第一方阵。
text_en: At the Shanghai municipal government press conference in the "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" series of thematic events, Zhao Yong, Party Secretary and Director of the Shanghai Municipal Administration of Culture and Tourism, introduced the newly issued and implemented "Shanghai Urban Tourism Innovation Development 15th Five-Year Plan." The Plan anchors three major goals: building China's first stop for inbound tourism, China's preferred destination for urban tourism, and a demonstration zone for deep integration of culture and tourism. It proposes that by 2030 Shanghai's tourism revenue strive to exceed 900 billion yuan, inbound tourists reach more than 10 million person-times, and the added value of the tourism industry account for 5% of the city's GDP, striving to rank among the first tier of global tourism.
